name: Crimson Death casts Slaughter an additional time free of cost (#2663)
contract: Crimson Death 705414 says Slaughter has a 20 percent chance to cast an additional time free of cost.
This is the original Spell.dbc ProcChance and rev_20260927_99 sets the effective spell_proc Chance to 20.
The original test assumed every Slaughter procced using an obsolete Chance=100 migration. This scenario
takes 200 independent normal casts against an execute-eligible target. Native costs, hit calculations and
proc rules remain enabled; fixture cooldown resets separate trials and each cast clears its normal GCD.
The registered numerical check requires exactly one or two completed casts per submission, unchanged
cost when a free extra cast occurs, and a sample consistent with 20 percent at exact binomial p >= 1e-6.
